Set the VPN to always on and block traffic when it disconnects. Keep the PIN available. Internet access may stop until the VPN works. Install only a certificate from the family filter you trust.
Remove the VPN and proxy settings from this profile, and remove the selected certificate from Android. Other Device Guard controls still follow their own settings.
Install only the public CA certificate from the family filter you trust. Apps that trust this certificate can have their encrypted traffic inspected by that filter.
Remove the selected certificate from Android. Apps that need it to use the filter may lose access.
